hero.title: Travel differently with passionate local guides
hero.subtitle: Discover cities through the eyes of their residents with our experienced local guides.

description.title: Why choose a local guide with LocoTrip?
description.paragraph1: LocoTrip is the ideal platform for travelers looking to explore cities with certified local guides. Our local guides offer personalized tours tailored to your interests, whether it's history, gastronomy, architecture, or culture.
description.paragraph2: Unlike traditional tourist tours, our local guides take you to hidden gems, vibrant neighborhoods, and help you discover the true soul of the cities you visit. Thanks to our smart matching system, you can easily find the perfect guide for your trip.

card3.title: Authentic encounters
card3.description: Engage with passionate guides and experience unforgettable moments

europe.title: LocoTrip: Local Guides Across Europe
europe.paragraph1: We aim to expand our network of local guides to 20 major European cities within the next 5 years. Whether you're visiting Paris, Rome, Barcelona, or Berlin, find a local guide that suits your needs and enjoy a unique experience.
europe.paragraph2: Our platform makes it easy for travelers to connect with local guides, offering you immersive adventures. You can explore hidden spots, taste local cuisine, and discover the authentic culture of each destination.
europe.paragraph3: We are committed to making travel more accessible and environmentally friendly by encouraging the use of sustainable transport, such as trains, to travel between European cities.

steps.title: How to book a local guide with LocoTrip?
steps.intro: Booking a local guide on LocoTrip is simple and fast. Follow these steps to enjoy a unique immersive experience with a local expert.

step1.title: Search for your destination
step1.description: Enter your city and explore the profiles of available local guides.

step2.title: Choose your guide
step2.description: Check reviews, experience, and specialties of each guide to find the one that meets your expectations.

step3.title: Book your slot
step3.description: Select a date that suits you and proceed with secure online booking.

step4.title: Enjoy your tour
step4.description: Meet your guide on the day and enjoy an authentic and memorable adventure.
